summary: Cellectis S.A. filed a Form 6-K on June 25, 2026, reporting the results of its annual shareholders' general meeting held that day. Approximately 55.84% of voting rights were exercised; resolutions 1 through 29 were adopted, and resolution 30 was rejected, consistent with the board's recommendations. This is a routine procedural update on shareholder voting outcomes, not a special situation. No deal terms, strategic change, or event triggering a special-situation classification is present. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of a routine meeting.
